subject: Mobile Development
title: The 60 Frames Per Second Target
description: One-minute skill: The 60 Frames Per Second Target.

hook.text: Scroll a list on your phone. If it stutters, something is wrong with the rendering.

buildup.text: Smooth scrolling requires the screen to redraw 60 times per second — every 16 milliseconds.

discovery.text: The GPU composites layers while the CPU handles logic, both racing against the clock.

twist.text: One heavy operation on the main thread can freeze the entire UI for visible milliseconds.

climax.text: 60fps is the threshold where motion feels fluid. Drop below it and users notice instantly.

punchline.text: Sixteen milliseconds is all you get per frame.

quiz.question: How often must the screen redraw for smooth scrolling?
